title: Left-handed
subtitle: 「左撇子／慣用左手」，究竟是哪一種左手偏好？
description: 「左撇子／慣用左手」，究竟是哪一種左手偏好？

words.meaning: 左手主導的；慣用左手的
words.note: 最直接、較正式的替換之一，常見於教育、醫療、人體動作或技能描述，表示左手是主要使用的一側。
words.example: The child is left-hand dominant and writes with her left hand.
words.exampleZh: 這名兒童以左手為主，並用左手寫字。

exercises.original: The teacher noted that the child was left-handed and consistently wrote with her left hand.
exercises.zh: 老師注意到這名兒童是左撇子，而且一直用左手寫字。
exercises.upgrade: left-hand dominant · 左手主導的；慣用左手的

options.explanation: ambidextrous = 如果 consistently 用左手，就不是雙手同等熟練的核心情況。
right-handed = 與句意相反。
left-hand dominant = consistently wrote with her left hand 明確表示左手為主要慣用手，因此 left-hand dominant 最精確。
left-sided = 只描述位置，不表示 hand dominance。
cross-dominant = 沒有不同任務分由不同側主導的線索。
dominant hand = 這是名詞概念，不能直接作此處形容詞替換。

exercises.original: The therapist recorded him as left-handed after observing which hand he used for fine-motor tasks.
exercises.zh: 治療師觀察他做精細動作時使用哪一隻手後，記錄他為左手主導。
exercises.upgrade: left-hand dominant · 左手主導的；慣用左手的

options.explanation: left-sided = 不是描述偏側位置。
ambidextrous = 若一側明顯主導，就不符合。
right-handed = 相反。
left-hand dominant = 臨床觀察用哪一隻手完成 fine-motor tasks，正是在判斷 hand dominance。
cross-dominant = 未見不同任務偏不同側。
left-wing = 完全無關。

exercises.original: The athlete is left-handed when throwing and serving.
exercises.zh: 這名運動員在投擲和發球時以左手為主。
exercises.upgrade: left-hand dominant · 左手主導的；慣用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed = 相反。
ambidextrous = 沒有雙手同等使用的證據。
left-sided = 不表示慣用手。
cross-dominant = 未提供其他任務相反主導側。
left-hand dominant = throwing 和 serving 都使用左手，最自然描述為 left-hand dominant。
hand preference = 詞性不合。

words.meaning: 較常使用左手；偏好左手
words.note: 描述性說法，強調在需要選擇使用哪一隻手時，通常傾向使用左手。
words.example: He is a student who prefers the left hand for writing and drawing.
words.exampleZh: 他是一名寫字和畫畫時偏好使用左手的學生。

exercises.original: She is left-handed when writing and drawing.
exercises.zh: 她寫字和畫畫時偏好使用左手。
exercises.upgrade: preferring the left hand · 較常使用左手；偏好左手

options.explanation: uses both hands equally = 與左手偏好不符。
is right-handed = 相反。
is left-sided = 不表示手部偏好。
preferring the left hand = writing 和 drawing 都傾向使用左手，因此 prefers the left hand 很自然。
has no hand preference = 與句意相反。
is cross-dominant = 未提供不同任務的交叉主導。

exercises.original: The child appears left-handed when choosing a crayon.
exercises.zh: 這名兒童在選擇蠟筆時看來偏好左手。
exercises.upgrade: preferring the left hand · 較常使用左手；偏好左手

options.explanation: to be ambidextrous = 沒有雙手同等使用線索。
to prefer the right hand = 相反。
to be left-sided = 概念錯誤。
to have no preference = 相反。
preferring the left hand = 選 crayon 時自然偏向左手，描述為 prefer the left hand 最直接。
to be cross-dominant = 只看單一任務無法支持。

exercises.original: He has always been left-handed for everyday tasks.
exercises.zh: 他做日常工作時一直偏好左手。
exercises.upgrade: preferring the left hand · 較常使用左手；偏好左手

options.explanation: used only the right hand = 相反。
been left-sided = 不等於 handedness。
been ambidextrous = 不符合明顯單側 preference。
had no dominant hand = 相反。
used whichever hand was injured = 語義不合。
preferring the left hand = 長期在 everyday tasks 中偏向左手，這個描述性說法完整保留原意。

words.note: 較簡潔，常見於運動、人體動作和功能描述；若只談手部，需讓上下文明確指出是 hand dominance。
words.example: The player is left-dominant when serving and throwing.
words.exampleZh: 這名球員在發球和投擲時以左手為主。

exercises.original: The player is left-handed in most racket and throwing activities.
exercises.zh: 這名球員在大部分球拍和投擲活動中以左手為主。
exercises.upgrade: left-dominant · 左側／左手主導的

options.explanation: right-dominant = 相反。
ambidextrous = 不符合 most activities 都偏左。
left-sided = 不表示功能主導。
cross-dominant = 未說不同活動使用不同側。
left-dominant = 運動功能中一側明顯主導，簡潔可說 left-dominant。
neutral-handed = 不是常規術語。

exercises.original: Testing showed that she was left-handed for manual precision tasks.
exercises.zh: 測試顯示她在手部精細任務中以左手為主。
exercises.upgrade: left-dominant · 左側／左手主導的

options.explanation: right-handed = 相反。
ambidextrous = 與明顯 dominance 不符。
left-sided = 不表示 task performance。
cross-dominant = 未有跨任務混合側別。
handedness = 是名詞概念。
left-dominant = manual precision tasks 令 dominance 語義清楚，因此 left-dominant 合適。

exercises.original: He is left-handed when performing most one-handed tasks.
exercises.zh: 他在大多數單手任務中以左手為主。
exercises.upgrade: left-dominant · 左側／左手主導的

options.explanation: left-dominant = most one-handed tasks 明確表示左手功能主導，因此 left-dominant 很自然。
ambidextrous = 不是雙手同等。
right-dominant = 相反。
left-sided = 概念不同。
cross-dominant = 沒有 mixed-task evidence。
dominant hand = 詞性不合。

words.note: 較正式、描述性，常見於研究、發展評估或教育語境，表示個人在手部選擇上偏向左手。
words.example: The assessment identified the child as having a clear left-hand preference.
words.exampleZh: 評估顯示這名兒童有明顯的左手偏好。

exercises.original: The assessment showed that the child was left-handed.
exercises.zh: 評估顯示這名兒童有左手偏好。
exercises.upgrade: having a left-hand preference · 具有左手偏好的

options.explanation: was right-handed = 相反。
was ambidextrous = 與 clear preference 不符。
was left-sided = 不表示手部偏好。
had no hand preference = 相反。
was cross-dominant = 未提供不同 task 的側別差異。
having a left-hand preference = assessment 語境中，以 had a clear left-hand preference 表達最正式自然。

exercises.original: Researchers classified participants as left-handed or right-handed.
exercises.zh: 研究人員把參加者分類為具有左手偏好或右手偏好。
exercises.upgrade: having a left-hand preference · 具有左手偏好的

options.explanation: having a left-hand preference = 研究分類 hand preference 時，having a left-hand preference 很自然。
being left-sided = 不是 handedness classification。
being ambidextrous = 只適合另一類 participants。
having no preference = 不是左手類別。
having a right-hand preference = 相反。
being left-wing = 完全無關。

exercises.original: The questionnaire identified her as left-handed.
exercises.zh: 問卷顯示她具有左手偏好。
exercises.upgrade: having a left-hand preference · 具有左手偏好的

options.explanation: having a right-hand preference = 相反。
having a left-hand preference = 問卷通常記錄的是 preference，而不是直接測量能力，因此這個說法很精確。
being left-sided = 概念錯誤。
being ambidextrous = 不等於左手偏好。
having no dominant hand = 相反。
being cross-dominant = 需更多 task-specific evidence。

words.note: 較正式，強調實際行為中大部分時間以左手完成特定動作。
words.example: She uses the left hand predominantly for writing and fine-motor tasks.
words.exampleZh: 她在寫字和精細動作中主要使用左手。

exercises.original: She is left-handed for writing, cutting, and using tools.
exercises.zh: 她在寫字、剪東西和使用工具時主要使用左手。
exercises.upgrade: using the left hand predominantly · 主要使用左手

options.explanation: using the left hand predominantly = 多個實際 task 都主要用左手，uses the left hand predominantly 最清楚。
uses both hands equally = 與 predominantly 左手不符。
uses the right hand predominantly = 相反。
is left-sided = 不描述 hand use。
has no hand preference = 不符多項一致使用左手。
is cross-dominant = 多項工作均偏左，不支持交叉主導。

exercises.original: He is left-handed in most fine-motor activities.
exercises.zh: 他在大多數精細動作中主要使用左手。
exercises.upgrade: using the left hand predominantly · 主要使用左手

options.explanation: uses the right hand predominantly = 相反。
using the left hand predominantly = most fine-motor activities 直接支持 predominantly。
is ambidextrous = 不符合一側主要使用。
is left-sided = 概念不同。
has no hand preference = 相反。
is right-dominant = 相反。

exercises.original: Observation showed that the student was left-handed during classroom tasks.
exercises.zh: 觀察顯示這名學生在課堂任務中主要使用左手。
exercises.upgrade: using the left hand predominantly · 主要使用左手

options.explanation: used both hands equally = 不符合 observed preference。
used the right hand predominantly = 相反。
using the left hand predominantly = 觀察的是實際使用頻率，因此 used the left hand predominantly 很精確。
was left-sided = 不等於手部使用習慣。
had no dominant hand = 不合。
was cross-dominant = 未提供不同 task 交叉使用的證據。

words.note: 自然的描述性說法，表示某人在多數任務中較傾向使用左手；美式常寫 favoring，英式常寫 favouring。
words.example: The toddler is already favoring the left hand when picking up small objects.
words.exampleZh: 這名幼兒在拿取小物件時已經較常使用左手。

exercises.original: The toddler is left-handed when reaching for small objects.
exercises.zh: 這名幼兒伸手拿小物件時較常用左手。
exercises.upgrade: favoring the left hand · 較常用左手；偏用左手

options.explanation: favoring the right hand = 相反。
favoring the left hand = 幼兒在自然 reaching task 中反覆選左手，favoring the left hand 很自然。
using both hands equally = 不表示偏好。
being left-sided = 不等於 handedness。
showing no preference = 相反。
being cross-dominant = 單一 reaching task 不足以支持。

exercises.original: She seems left-handed when picking up a spoon.
exercises.zh: 她拿湯匙時似乎較常用左手。
exercises.upgrade: favoring the left hand · 較常用左手；偏用左手

options.explanation: favor the right hand = 相反。
be ambidextrous = 沒有雙手同等線索。
favoring the left hand = 單一自然選手動作顯示傾向左手，用 favor the left hand 最貼切。
be left-sided = 概念不對。
have no preference = 相反。
be cross-dominant = 未有跨任務資料。

exercises.original: The child is becoming clearly left-handed during play.
exercises.zh: 這名兒童在玩耍時愈來愈明顯偏用左手。
exercises.upgrade: favoring the left hand · 較常用左手；偏用左手

options.explanation: favoring the right hand = 相反。
using both hands equally = 與 increasingly 偏左不符。
being left-sided = 不合。
favoring the left hand = increasingly 表示偏好逐漸明顯，因此 favoring the left hand 很自然。
showing no dominance = 相反。
becoming ambidextrous = 不合。

words.note: 表示整體上屬左撇子，但某些特定活動可能會使用右手；比單純 left-handed 稍具彈性。
words.example: He is primarily left-handed but uses his right hand for a few sports.
words.exampleZh: 他主要慣用左手，但做少數運動時會用右手。

exercises.original: He is left-handed, although he uses his right hand for a few sports.
exercises.zh: 他主要慣用左手，但做少數運動時會用右手。
exercises.upgrade: primarily left-handed · 主要慣用左手的

options.explanation: completely ambidextrous = 不同活動使用不同手不等於雙手同等熟練。
right-handed = 整體主導手相反。
primarily left-handed = 整體偏左但有少數例外，primarily left-handed 最精確。
left-sided = 不表示手部慣用。
without a hand preference = 相反。
right-dominant = 與 primarily left-handed 不符。

exercises.original: She is left-handed for most tasks but throws a ball with her right hand.
exercises.zh: 她大部分任務慣用左手，但投球用右手。
exercises.upgrade: primarily left-handed · 主要慣用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed = 不能概括 most tasks。
ambidextrous = 未說雙手在相同 tasks 同樣熟練。
left-sided = 不合。
primarily left-handed = most tasks + one exception 很適合 primarily left-handed。
without dominance = 相反。
entirely right-dominant = 相反。

exercises.original: Although he sometimes switches hands, he is left-handed overall.
exercises.zh: 雖然他有時會換手，但整體上主要慣用左手。
exercises.upgrade: primarily left-handed · 主要慣用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed = 相反。
ambidextrous = 偶爾換手不等於雙手同等能力。
left-sided = 概念不同。
cross-dominant = 可能接近，但本句沒有穩定的 task-specific split。
primarily left-handed = overall 的意思最自然可由 primarily left-handed 表達。
without hand preference = 相反。

words.meaning: 偏好用左手的；慣用左手的
words.note: 強調使用左手主要源於自然偏好或習慣，而不是暫時受傷、環境限制等外在原因。
words.example: She is left-handed by preference rather than because of any injury.
words.exampleZh: 她使用左手是出於自然偏好，而不是因為受傷。

exercises.original: She is left-handed, not because of an injury but because that is naturally more comfortable.
exercises.zh: 她使用左手不是因為受傷，而是因為自然覺得較舒服。
exercises.upgrade: left-handed by preference · 偏好用左手的；慣用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed by preference = 相反。
ambidextrous = 不表示自然偏左。
left-sided = 不合。
left-handed by preference = not because of an injury 明確說明左手使用來自自然偏好，因此 left-handed by preference 很精確。
cross-dominant = 不是 injury vs preference 的重點。
without hand preference = 相反。

exercises.original: He writes with his left hand because he naturally prefers it.
exercises.zh: 他因自然偏好而用左手寫字。
exercises.upgrade: left-handed by preference · 偏好用左手的；慣用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed by preference = 相反。
left-sided = 不合。
ambidextrous = 未說雙手同等。
cross-dominant = 沒有其他 task data。
left-handed by preference = naturally prefers it 直接對應 by preference。
without preference = 相反。

exercises.original: The switch to her left hand was not temporary; she has always been left-handed.
exercises.zh: 她改用左手不是暫時的；她一直都偏好使用左手。
exercises.upgrade: left-handed by preference · 偏好用左手的；慣用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed by preference = 相反。
left-sided = 不表示 handedness。
ambidextrous = 不符合長期偏左。
cross-dominant = 未提供跨活動分化。
without a dominant hand = 相反。
left-handed by preference = 長期、非暫時的自然偏好可清楚說 left-handed by preference。

words.note: 較正式，適合研究、問卷或臨床描述，常用來分類受試者或描述手部偏好。
words.example: Participants with a left-hand preference were analysed separately.
words.exampleZh: 具有左手偏好的參加者被分開分析。

exercises.original: Participants who were left-handed were analysed separately.
exercises.zh: 具有左手偏好的參加者被分開分析。
exercises.upgrade: with a left-hand preference · 具有左手偏好的

options.explanation: with a right-hand preference = 相反。
who were left-sided = 不是 handedness category。
with no preference = 相反。
who were ambidextrous = 另一分類。
with a left-hand preference = 研究分組時以名詞化方式描述 handedness，with a left-hand preference 很自然。
with cross-dominance = 不同概念。

exercises.original: The study included thirty left-handed adults.
exercises.zh: 研究包括三十名具有左手偏好的成年人。
exercises.upgrade: with a left-hand preference · 具有左手偏好的

options.explanation: with a right-hand preference = 相反。
with left-sided injuries = 不等於 handedness。
without hand preference = 不合。
with ambidexterity = 另一類別。
with cross-dominance = 不完全相同。
with a left-hand preference = 研究樣本分類可正式寫成 adults with a left-hand preference。

exercises.original: Children identified as left-handed completed an additional task.
exercises.zh: 被辨識為具有左手偏好的兒童完成了一項額外任務。
exercises.upgrade: with a left-hand preference · 具有左手偏好的

options.explanation: with a left-hand preference = 在研究或評估中把一群兒童按 hand preference 描述，這個詞組最精確。
with a right-hand preference = 相反。
who were left-sided = 不合。
without dominance = 相反。
with ambidexterity = 不等同。
with right-side dominance = 相反。

words.meaning: 實際上主要使用左手的
words.note: 描述性說法，強調實際操作時主要使用左手，即使某人的手部偏好在不同活動中不完全一致。
words.example: Although he uses both hands, he is left-handed in practice for most precision tasks.
words.exampleZh: 雖然他雙手都會用，但在大多數精細工作中實際上主要使用左手。

exercises.original: Although he can use both hands, he is left-handed for most precision work.
exercises.zh: 雖然他雙手都會用，但大多數精細工作實際上主要使用左手。
exercises.upgrade: left-handed in practice · 實際上主要使用左手的

options.explanation: fully ambidextrous = 能用雙手不代表 precision tasks 上同等熟練。
right-handed = 與 most precision work 偏左不符。
left-sided = 不表示實際用手。
without a dominant hand = 相反。
right-dominant in practice = 相反。
left-handed in practice = 有能力使用雙手，但實際大多數 precision work 用左手，left-handed in practice 很貼切。

exercises.original: Officially he reports mixed hand use, but in everyday tasks he is left-handed.
exercises.zh: 他正式自報雙手混合使用，但在日常任務中實際主要用左手。
exercises.upgrade: left-handed in practice · 實際上主要使用左手的

options.explanation: left-handed in practice = 自我分類可能 mixed，但實際行為偏左，left-handed in practice 正好區分 reported identity 和實際使用。
right-handed in practice = 相反。
ambidextrous in every task = 不符合 everyday tasks 偏左。
left-sided = 不合。
without preference = 相反。
right-dominant = 相反。

exercises.original: She sometimes switches hands, yet most of her detailed work is done with the left hand.
exercises.zh: 她有時會換手，但大部分精細工作仍用左手完成。
exercises.upgrade: left-handed in practice · 實際上主要使用左手的

options.explanation: right-handed in practice = 相反。
left-handed in practice = 實際 detailed work 多數由左手完成，因此這個描述性說法很自然。
fully ambidextrous = switching hands 不等於同等熟練。
left-sided = 不合。
without a dominant hand = 與 most work 用左手不符。
cross-dominant = 未明確顯示不同任務穩定由不同側主導。

falseSynonyms.zh: 雙手靈活不等於左撇子 ambidextrous 表示左右手都能熟練使用；left-handed 則表示左手是主要慣用手。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An ambidextrous person uses both hands well; a left-handed person primarily uses the left hand.

falseSynonyms.zh: 右撇子與左撇子相反 right-handed 表示主要使用右手，和 left-handed 意思相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A right-handed person usually writes with the right hand.

falseSynonyms.zh: 左側的不等於左撇子 left-sided 只表示位置或身體左側；不一定表示手部慣用左手。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A left-sided injury affects the left side of the body but does not describe handedness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 左翼不等於左手慣用 left-wing 通常是政治或隊形位置用語，和手部偏好無關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Left-wing describes a political position or playing position, not handedness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 慣用手不等於一定是左手 dominant hand 是主要使用的手，可以是左手也可以是右手。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person's dominant hand may be the left or the right hand.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞短語與形容詞不同 left hand 是左手這個身體部位；left-handed 是形容詞，表示慣用左手。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She raised her left hand. She is left-handed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偏好概念與特定左手偏好不同 hand preference 或 handedness 是一般概念，並未說明是左手還是右手。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Handedness describes which hand a person tends to prefer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 交叉優勢不等於左撇子 cross-dominant 表示不同任務可能由不同側主導，例如寫字用左手但踢球用右腳；不等於整體 left-handed。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cross-dominant person may prefer different sides for different tasks.
